# Funding source (`funding-source` v1)

A source of funding: deposits, repo or issuance, with its LCR run-off assumption.

**Group:** Liquidity · **Mnemonic:** `FUND` · **Identifiers:** `FUND-…` in `fundingId`

Open one with `FUND <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: funding-source
version: 1
description: "A source of funding: deposits, repo or issuance, with its LCR run-off assumption."
match: { kind: funding-source, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Liquidity · Funding source, id: $.fundingId }
strip:
  - { label: Provider, bind: $.counterpartyName }
  - { label: Type, bind: $.type }
  - { label: Amount, bind: $.amount, fmt: amount0, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Currency, bind: $.currency }
  - { label: Maturity, bind: $.maturity, fmt: date }
  - { label: Run-off, bind: $.runOffRate, fmt: pct0 }
panels:
  - id: terms
    kind: kv
    title: Terms
    key: F2
    rows: $.terms
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.counterparty, 'counterparty')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
